//overrides: Transitive dependencies pinned above a published advisory. Nothing in the tree
declares any of these directly at the vulnerable version, so a range bump on our
own dependencies cannot reach them — an override is the only lever.
Each selector is scoped to the advisory's own vulnerable range rather than the
bare package name: an unconditional override would drag every major in the tree
up to one version, which is how a security patch turns into a build break.
The brace-expansion entry has widened once already (GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp, then
GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 and its follow-up). Widen the range here rather than adding
a second entry, so two selectors can never disagree about the same version.
